[[File:Carbonsources.jpg|thumb|Carbon Processing Center.]]
'''Carbon processing centers''' were structures used to convert raw harvested [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]] into [[Duraplast/Legends|duraplast]]. Constructed by [[Droid/Legends|droid]] or organic workers, Carbon processing centers were used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]], [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], and [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].

{{Struct-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Carbon processing centers serve as resource drop-off buildings in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' and its [[2002]] [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|expansion pack]].
